title: 第二十二章殷无极第23章密道
content_zh:
方天正的嘴唇在哆嗦。
不是害怕，是愤怒。七十岁的老人，在方家待了六十二年，被人用毒控制了两年的屈辱、恐惧和愤怒，此刻全部涌了上来，堵在喉咙里，让他一个字都说不出来。
方圆没有催他。
他静静地蹲在方天正面前，等着。夜风从塌了一半的院墙外吹进来，带着泥土和血腥的气息。天机阁主留下的那道白色剑光已经散尽，但空气中还残留着化神境剑意的余韵，压得人喘不过气。
方天正深吸了几口气，终于开口了。
“他叫……殷无极。”
这个名字说出口的一瞬间，方天正像是卸下了千斤重担，整个人的精气神都垮了下来，瘫坐在台阶上，大口大口地喘气。
方圆的眼睛眯了起来。
殷无极。
这个名字，他不陌生。
前世的记忆中，有一个叫殷无极的人——中州殷家的庶出子弟，天赋平庸，心术不正，因修炼邪功被殷家逐出家门。后来此人投靠了某个神秘势力，修为暴涨，在中州掀起了一场腥风血雨。
但那是一百年前的事了。
一百年后，殷无极的肉身应该早就腐朽了。除非——他像烈无双一样，夺舍了别人的身体。
“殷无极是什么人？”方圆问。
方天正摇了摇头：“我只知道他是从中州来的，二十年前就到了青州。他夺舍了烈阳宗宗主烈无双的身体，但烈无双的身体和他的元神不匹配，修为一直卡在筑基境九重巅峰，突破不了金丹。”
“所以他需要方家的资源来突破？”方圆追问。
“对。三年前他找到我，那时候我刚当上大长老，他说他能帮我突破到金丹境，条件是——方家的灵器、灵石、丹药，他要分走三成。”
方天正苦笑了一声，继续说：“我当时鬼迷心窍，答应了。但我没想到他给我下了毒。等我发现不对劲的时候，毒已经深入骨髓了。从那时起，我就成了他的傀儡。他让我做什么，我就做什么。不是我想做，是我不得不做。”
方圆沉默。
三成。

方家每年产出的灵器、灵石、丹药，三成流入了殷无极的口袋。一年两年看不出来，三年累积下来，是一个惊人的数字。
这些资源用在殷无极身上，帮他做了两件事——第一，维持他那个与肉身不匹配的元神不散；第二，为他的“最后一步”做准备。
“最后一步”是什么？
天机阁主说，殷无极需要的东西已经拿到了。方家的资源，就是那个“东西”。
“殷无极现在是什么修为？”方圆问。
“金丹境三重。”方天正说，“三年前他刚夺舍烈无双的时候，只有筑基境三重。三年，用方家的资源硬生生堆到了金丹三重。如果他拿到了他想要的所有东西，下一步就是——突破元婴。”
方圆的心猛地一沉。
金丹三重到元婴境，隔着六重小境界和一个大境界。正常修炼，一个天才武者从金丹到元婴需要五十年到一百年。但殷无极不是正常武者，他修炼的是邪功，吞噬他人修为为己用，速度是正常修炼的十倍不止。
如果让他到了元婴境，整个青州将无人能挡。
“他现在的藏身之处在哪？”方圆问。
方天正摇头：“我不知道。他每次来找我，都是突然出现、突然消失。我怀疑方家地下有一条密道，通向某个地方。但他从来不让我知道具体位置。”
方圆站起身，在塌了一半的院子里来回踱步。
方家地下有密道，通向殷无极的藏身之处。天机阁主之前说过，殷无极“一直在方家地下”。这说明密道的入口就在方家大院范围内。
他停下脚步，脑海中浮现出方家大院的平面图。
content_en:
Fang Tianzheng's lips were trembling.
Not scared, but angry. The seventy-year-old man had stayed in the Fang family for sixty-two years, and the humiliation, fear, and anger that had been controlled by poison for two years all surged up at this moment and were blocked in his throat, making him unable to say a word.
Fangyuan didn't rush him.
He squatted quietly in front of Fang Tian, ​​waiting. The night wind blew in from outside the half-collapsed courtyard wall, carrying the smell of earth and blood. The white sword light left by the master of the Tianji Pavilion has dissipated, but the aftertaste of the sword intent of the God Transformation realm still lingers in the air, making people breathless.
Fang Tianzheng took a few deep breaths and finally spoke.
"His name is...Yin Wuji."
The moment the name was spoken, Fang Tianzheng seemed to have been relieved of a thousand kilograms of weight, and his whole body collapsed. He collapsed on the steps, gasping for air.
Fangyuan's eyes narrowed.
Yin Wuji.
This name is not unfamiliar to him.
In the memory of the previous life, there was a man named Yin Wuji - a commoner son of the Yin family in Zhongzhou. He had mediocre talent and evil intentions. He was expelled by the Yin family for practicing evil arts. Later, this person took refuge in a mysterious force, and his cultivation level skyrocketed, causing a bloody storm in Zhongzhou.
But that was a hundred years ago.
A hundred years later, Yin Wuji's body should have long since decayed. Unless - like Lie Wushuang, he takes away other people's bodies.
"Who is Yin Wuji?" Fangyuan asked.
Fang Tianzheng shook his head: "I only know that he came from Zhongzhou and arrived in Qingzhou twenty years ago. He took away the body of Lie Wushuang, the leader of Lieyang Sect, but Lie Wushuang's body did not match his soul. His cultivation has been stuck at the ninth level of the Foundation Establishment Realm, and he could not break through the golden elixir."
"So he needs the Fang family's resources to break through?" Fang Yuan asked.
"Yes. He found me three years ago, when I just became the Great Elder. He said that he could help me break through to the Golden Elixir Realm. The condition was that he would share 30% of the Fang family's spiritual weapons, spiritual stones, and elixirs."
Fang Tianzheng gave a bitter smile and continued: "I was obsessed at the time and agreed. But I didn't expect that he poisoned me. By the time I realized something was wrong, the poison had already penetrated deep into my bones. From then on, I became his puppet. I did whatever he asked me to do. It wasn't that I wanted to do it, but that I had to do it."
Fangyuan was silent.
Thirty percent.
Thirty percent of the spiritual weapons, spiritual stones, and elixirs produced by the Fang family every year flow into Yin Wuji's pocket. It can't be seen in one or two years, but accumulated over three years, it is an astonishing number.
These resources were used on Yin Wuji to do two things for him - first, to maintain his soul that did not match his physical body; second, to prepare for his "last step".
What is the "last step"?
The master of Tianji Pavilion said that Yin Wuji had already obtained what he needed. The Fang family's resources are that "thing".
"What level of cultivation is Yin Wuji now?" Fang Yuan asked.
"The third level of the Golden Core Realm." Fang Tianzheng said, "When he first captured Shelie Wushuang three years ago, he only had the third level of the Foundation Establishment Realm. In three years, he used the Fang family's resources to reach the third level of the Golden Core Realm. If he gets everything he wants, the next step is to break through the Nascent Soul."
Fangyuan's heart sank suddenly.
From the third level of Jindan to the Nascent Soul realm, there is a sixth level of small realm and one big realm. With normal cultivation, it takes fifty to a hundred years for a talented warrior to go from Golden Elixir to Nascent Soul. But Yin Wuji is not a normal warrior. He practices evil skills, devouring other people's cultivation for his own use, and the speed is more than ten times that of normal cultivation.
If he is allowed to reach the Nascent Soul Realm, the entire Qingzhou will be unstoppable.
"Where is his hiding place now?" Fang Yuan asked.
Fang Tianzheng shook his head: "I don't know. Every time he comes to see me, he appears and disappears suddenly. I suspect there is a secret passage under the Fang family that leads to somewhere. But he never lets me know the specific location."
Fangyuan stood up and stood in the half-collapsed courtyard.He was pacing back and forth.
There is a secret passage under the Fang family that leads to Yin Wuji's hiding place. The Master of Tianji Pavilion said before that Yin Wuji "has always been underground in the Fang family." This shows that the entrance to the secret passage is within the Fang family compound.
He stopped and the floor plan of the Fang family compound appeared in his mind.
